description: This file declares external functions related to the RTL8367C switch's miscellaneous API operations, such as setting/getting MAC address, debug info, port jam mode, and max length configurations.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the switch ASIC.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the switch ASIC.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicDebugInfo
methods.description: Fetches debug information for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Sets the jam mode configuration for the port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Retrieves the jam mode configuration for the port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Configures the maximum length setting for a specific configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum length configuration for a given configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum length parameter for a specific port and type.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum length parameter for a specific port and type.
